description: This file defines the CustomerAttribute entity class, which models a customer's attribute in the sales management system. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, including relationships to Customer, CustomerOption, and CustomerOptionValue entities, and includes fields for attribute ID and text value.

classes.name: CustomerAttribute
classes.description: An entity representing a customer-specific attribute, with references to customer options and values, and the customer itself.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the Customer associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the Customer associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getTextValue
methods.description: Returns the text value of the attribute.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.description: Sets the text value of the attribute.
